title: Property Wrapper: @Clamped
hints: A `@propertyWrapper` needs a `wrappedValue`; `projectedValue` is exposed as `$name`.
Clamp in the `wrappedValue` setter and count how often a write was clamped in `projectedValue`.
`init(wrappedValue: Value, _ range: ClosedRange<Value>)` — then `@Clamped(0...100) var volume = 50`.
jsBridge: Property wrappers (`@Clamped`) package get/set logic for reuse, like decorators on class fields in TS (`@observable`, or validation decorators). `@State`, `@Published` and `@AppStorage` are all property wrappers, and `$name` is the projected value.
